About Per4mance Guru

We Grow Brands.
Not Just Follower Counts.

We're a Delhi-based performance marketing agency that obsesses over one thing — results. Not impressions. Not reach. Real, measurable, business-changing results.

Our Story

Born from Frustration.
Built for Performance.

Per4mance Guru didn't start in a glass-walled office with a ping-pong table. It started with a genuine frustration — watching great brands waste money on agencies that chased vanity metrics, produced beautiful-looking reports, and delivered zero actual growth.

We saw businesses in Delhi pouring lakhs into digital marketing that felt disconnected from revenue. Agencies more focused on MQLs and reach numbers than on whether the client's business was actually growing. That gap — between marketing activity and business outcomes — is exactly where Per4mance Guru was built to sit.

Today, we operate across India, UAE, Sri Lanka, and Canada — managing performance campaigns, building organic presence, producing scroll-stopping creatives, and helping brands across D2C, luxury fashion, education, wellness, real estate, and beyond grow sustainably in a noisy digital world.

Our base is Delhi. Our reach is global. Our obsession is performance.

What Drives Us

Mission & Vision

🎯
Our Mission

Make Every Rupee Work Harder

Our mission is to bridge the gap between marketing spend and business growth — ensuring that every campaign, every piece of content, and every creative decision is tied to a real business outcome. We exist to make performance marketing genuinely accessible and transparent for brands across India and beyond.

We don't just manage campaigns. We become partners in your growth — embedded in your numbers, accountable for your results, and invested in your success the way a co-founder would be.

🔭
Our Vision

Become India's Most Trusted Growth Partner

We're building towards a future where Per4mance Guru is the first name Delhi — and eventually India — thinks of when they need a marketing partner they can trust with their most important growth challenges.

A world where brands don't have to choose between creative excellence and data-driven performance. Where local businesses in Rohini compete on the same digital playing field as multinationals in Connaught Place. Where ROI isn't a buzzword — it's a guarantee.

What We Stand For

The Values Behind
Every Decision

📊

Data Over Opinions

We don't run campaigns on gut feel or industry fashion. Every strategy is grounded in data — real numbers from real accounts, real customer behaviour, and real market conditions. If the data says pivot, we pivot — even if it contradicts our previous recommendation.

🔍

Radical Transparency

You'll always know exactly what's happening with your campaigns, your budget, and your results. No jargon, no smoke-and-mirrors reporting, no hiding underperforming numbers inside a slideshow. We give you the full picture — good and bad — every single month.

🚀

Bias for Action

We move fast. We test fast. We learn fast. The digital landscape changes weekly — algorithms shift, audiences evolve, creatives fatigue. We've built a culture where speed and decisiveness are as valued as strategic thinking. Paralysis by analysis is the enemy of growth.

🤝

Client Partnership, Not Clientship

We treat our clients' businesses like our own. That means asking hard questions, pushing back when we disagree, and bringing strategic thinking that goes beyond the scope of the brief. Your win is our win. Your growth numbers are what we wake up thinking about.

🎨

Creative Courage

Safe, predictable creative doesn't stop scrolls or change minds. We push for ideas that feel different — that take a stand, tell a real story, or challenge a category convention. We believe that the most effective marketing is always creative first, data-optimised second.

📈

Long-Term Thinking

We don't optimise for the monthly report. We optimise for sustainable, compounding growth. Sometimes that means recommending a slower, harder path over the quick-win shortcut. We're in this for the long haul — and we want clients who are too.

Our Journey

From One Client to
50+ Brands

2019 — The Beginning

Started with a Single Client & a Bold Promise

Per4mance Guru launched in Delhi with one founding belief: that performance marketing in India was broken — too much spend on awareness, too little accountability for revenue. We took our first client in the D2C space and delivered 3x ROAS in Month 2. Word spread.

2020 — Surviving & Pivoting

Built for Resilience During the Pandemic

When COVID shut down physical businesses, we doubled down on digital — helping clients pivot to e-commerce, build online audiences, and survive through smart, efficient marketing when budgets were slashed. That year taught us how to do more with less, and it made us permanently better at it.

2021 — Going Beyond Delhi

First International Clients & Multi-Market Campaigns

Our first UAE client came through a referral from a satisfied Delhi brand. That opened the door to a new market — and a new understanding of how digital marketing needs to adapt across geographies, currencies, and cultural contexts. Canada followed shortly after.

2022 — Scale & Systems

Built the Infrastructure for Repeatable Growth

With 20+ clients across three markets, we invested in systems — reporting infrastructure, creative production workflows, SEO content engines, and campaign management processes that could scale without sacrificing quality. We grew the team and launched our Local SEO practice for Delhi.

2023 — AI Transformation

Embraced AI-Powered Creative Production

We were early adopters of AI creative tools — integrating Midjourney, Kling, Runway, and automation platforms into our creative production workflow. This unlocked the ability to deliver enterprise-quality creative output at startup-friendly budgets, transforming our offer for D2C and SME clients.

2024–25 — Today

50+ Brands, 4 Markets, One Obsession

Today, Per4mance Guru manages campaigns for brands across India, UAE, Sri Lanka, and Canada — covering the full growth stack from paid performance to content to creative to SEO. We cover 80+ Delhi localities with dedicated local SEO pages and are building towards becoming Delhi's most trusted digital growth partner.

Common Questions

Process FAQs

How long before I see results? +

For paid campaigns, you'll see initial data within 7–14 days of launch. Meaningful ROAS improvement typically shows up in weeks 4–6 as we complete our first optimisation cycle. SEO results compound over 3–6 months. We'll set realistic, agreed expectations in your strategy session before anything goes live.

Do I need a minimum budget? +

For paid advertising, we recommend a minimum ad spend of ₹50,000/month to generate enough data for meaningful optimisation. Below this, the algorithm doesn't have enough to learn from and results are unreliable. Our management fee is separate from your ad spend budget.

Will I have access to my own accounts? +

Always. We work inside your own ad accounts — we never create agency-owned accounts on your behalf. You have full visibility and access at all times. If we ever part ways, you take everything with you: the accounts, the data, the audiences, the learnings.

How often will we communicate? +

You'll receive a weekly performance summary every Monday morning and a full monthly report in the first week of each month. We're also available on WhatsApp for quick questions. For significant developments — good or bad — we proactively reach out rather than waiting for a scheduled call.

What if something isn't working? +

We flag underperformance before you notice it. If a campaign is below efficiency targets for more than 5 days, we initiate a strategy conversation. We'll never keep spending on something that isn't working just to run out the month. We'd rather have a hard conversation early than a bigger problem later.

Do you work with all business types? +

We're most effective for D2C brands, e-commerce businesses, service businesses, educational institutions, and local businesses in Delhi. We have deep experience in fashion, wellness, education, eldercare, real estate, and coworking. We'll tell you honestly if we think we're not the right fit — we'd rather say that upfront than waste your budget finding out.

Why Local SEO
Matters in Delhi

Delhi is not one market — it's 80+ micro-markets, each with its own audience behaviour, competition landscape, and search patterns. A business in Rohini competes differently than one in Connaught Place. A customer in Lajpat Nagar searches differently than one in Dwarka.

Generic "Delhi digital marketing" doesn't capture this nuance. Hyper-local SEO does. When your business ranks for "digital marketing agency in Rohini" — not just "digital marketing agency Delhi" — you capture a buyer who is already in your market, already near your office, and already ready to convert.

This is why Per4mance Guru has invested in 80+ individually optimised locality pages — each with unique content, local business context, and area-specific SEO signals that generic agencies simply don't build. Read how we do it →

Our office in Gujaranwala Town, North Delhi means we don't just market Delhi — we live in it. We know which areas are growing fastest, which business categories are most competitive, and exactly what it takes to rank in each locality.

📍 80+ Localities, One Agency

From Burari in the north to Chhatarpur in the south, Mundka in the west to Vasundhara Enclave in the east — we cover all of Delhi with individually optimised content and campaigns.

🗺️ GMB Management Included

Every local SEO engagement includes Google My Business optimisation — profile setup, posts, review management, and photo strategy. GMB is the #1 driver of local search visibility.

🎯 Hyper-Local Targeting

Our Meta and Google Ads campaigns can target by specific Delhi pin codes and locality — ensuring your ad spend reaches exactly the neighbourhood your business serves.

📈 Local Rankings in 90 Days

Our clients typically begin seeing Google Maps ranking improvements for their locality within 8–12 weeks of starting our local SEO programme.
